summary: Computes an anisotropic scalar triple product: a2 cross a3, each cross-product component scaled by a per-axis factor stored in the object (this[3402]/this[3403]/this[3404], byte offsets 0x3528/0x352C/0x3530), dotted with a2, then a bias term this[3398] (byte offset 0x3518) is added. No branches, no calls. Part of an anisotropic force/spring computation.

operations.description: v8 = a2[0]*a3[1] - a3[0]*a2[1], the z-component of the cross product a2 x a3.
v9 = (a3[2]*a2[1] - a3[1]*a2[2]) * this[3402], the x-component of the cross product scaled by the anisotropic factor at byte offset 0x3528.
v3 = (a3[0]*a2[2] - a2[0]*a3[2]) * this[3403], the y-component of the cross product scaled by the anisotropic factor at byte offset 0x352C.
v4 = v8 * this[3404], the z-component of the cross product scaled by the anisotropic factor at byte offset 0x3530.
v6 = v3*a2[2] - v4*a2[1] and v7 = v4*a2[0] - v9*a2[2], intermediate weighted terms against a2.
Combine with a3: (v9*a2[1] - v3*a2[0])*a3[2] + v7*a3[1] + v6*a3[0], the anisotropic triple product.
Return the triple product plus the bias term this[3398] at byte offset 0x3518.

unresolved: Meaning of the anisotropic scale factors (0x3528/0x352C/0x3530) and the bias term (0x3518) depends on the owning object, unknown here.
The geometry semantics of a2/a3 (position vectors, offsets) are caller-defined by VehicleGeometryProximityTest (0x004ED420).
